rules.text: Return requests must be submitted within 72 hours from delivery and before the transaction is completed.
rules.quote: Return requests submitted within 72 hours from delivery (based on the carrier’s timestamp) and before the transaction is completed will be considered for the following reasons:

rules.text: Returns or refunds are not permitted after the transaction has been completed.
rules.quote: After a transaction has been completed, returns or refunds are not permitted.

rules.text: Items that violate Mercari's Terms of Service including prohibited items cannot be returned.
rules.quote: Mercari will not return items that violate our Terms of Service including items that are prohibited to sell.

rules.category: swimwear, lingerie, undergarments, opened beauty products, earrings or other body adornments
rules.text: Some items like swimwear, lingerie, undergarments, opened beauty products, earrings or other body adornments are typically non-returnable for hygiene reasons.
rules.quote: Some items, like swimwear, lingerie, undergarments, opened beauty products, earrings or other body adornments are typically non-returnable for hygiene reasons.

rules.text: Buyers must drop off the item with the designated carrier using the Mercari-provided return label within 72 hours of receipt of the label.
rules.quote: The buyer must drop off the item with the designated carrier using the Mercari-provided return label within 72 hours of receipt of the label, as confirmed by the carrier's first scan timestamp.

rules.text: For items over 50 pounds, sellers must provide their own shipping labels for returns.
rules.quote: For returns of items over 50 pounds, sellers must provide their own shipping labels.

rules.text: Completed returns will be refunded to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Completed returns will be refunded to the original form of payment.

rules.text: Refunds will be processed within 14 calendar days of confirmation that the buyer returned the item using the Mercari-provided return label.
rules.quote: The refund will be processed within 14 calendar days of confirmation that the buyer returned the item to the seller using the Mercari-provided return label.

rules.text: Returns are not permitted and refunds will not be issued if the buyer has rated the item or does not contact Mercari to request a return within 72 hours of receipt.
rules.quote: If a buyer has rated the item or does not contact Mercari to request a return within 72 hours of receipt of an item, a return will not be permitted and a refund will not be issued.

rules.text: Returns are only eligible for items significantly not as described, damaged during shipping, or counterfeit; other reasons are not mandatory for return acceptance.
rules.quote:
Return requests submitted within 72 hours from delivery (based on the carrier’s timestamp) and before the transaction is completed will be considered for the following reasons:

*   Item is significantly not as described in the listing
*   Item was damaged during shipping
*   Item is inauthentic/counterfeit

If the buyer’s concern is not eligible for a return under Mercari’s Return Policy, the seller may choose – but is not required – to accept a return.
